description: Strength for Today, Year 3. Scripture-grounded doctrinal revision drafts; not independently edited or approved for publication.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Return to the Word
entries.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Pray over the passage before acting.
entries.prayer: Father, give me courage to admit when i am wrong that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival is not noise or excitement alone; it calls for renewed love, prayer, repentance, and obedience before God. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Pray over the passage before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, give me courage to admit when i am wrong that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Sanctification is God's gracious work, not an excuse for careless living or self-righteousness. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Ask how the passage corrects your assumptions.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my heart free from bitterness that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: When answers delay, continue to pray and fulfil the responsibilities before you. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Choose a quiet act of obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, help me honour you when no one is watching that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Do not let public prayer replace secret devotion and obedient living. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Take responsibility for the next faithful step.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to show mercy without compromising truth that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ's death and resurrection are central to the gospel, not our personal achievements. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Let this teaching shape the words you use.
topics.prayer: Father, make me patient when answers are delayed that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust the Lord enough to tell the truth even when deception looks convenient. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider whom you can serve today.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me to care for those who are overlooked that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness for Christ and glorify Him. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Examine whether your motives agree with Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, guard my speech from pride and anger that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The aim of evangelism is to point people to Christ, not to win an argument. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Recall the Lord's faithfulness as you decide.
topics.prayer: Father, help me repair harm where i can that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Do not spread a rumour when you could seek understanding and peace. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Bring the matter before God in humble prayer.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my priorities shaped by eternity that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Obey what Scripture teaches even when no one is watching. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Respond with the patience Christ teaches.
topics.prayer: Father, open my eyes to a neighbour's need that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom listens carefully and resists hasty judgment. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Seek to repair what has been damaged.
topics.prayer: Father, help me keep my promises that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Encourage believers to remain steadfast rather than stirring fear with speculation. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Choose truth rather than convenience.
topics.prayer: Father, make my witness sincere and compassionate that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — A Heart Set Apart
entries.reflection: Do not excuse a dishonest action because it seems small; a clean conscience honours Christ. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Put the lesson into practice without delay.
entries.prayer: Father, teach me to forgive as you have forgiven me that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Do not mistake a crowded meeting for a revived heart. Ask whether Scripture is shaping your private choices. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Show compassion while holding to the truth.
topics.prayer: Father, give me strength to resist temptation that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Do not excuse a dishonest action because it seems small; a clean conscience honours Christ. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Put the lesson into practice without delay.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to forgive as you have forgiven me that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Bring your anxious thoughts to the Lord and support someone else with practical care. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Seek counsel rooted in Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful in small responsibilities that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Intercede for family, the church, and the spread of the gospel with humility. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Turn from any compromise the passage exposes.
topics.prayer: Father, help me honour scripture above popular opinion that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Speak of judgment with reverence and present the mercy offered in Christ. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Practice gratitude alongside faithful action.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom to discern what is right that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith rests on God's truth and is expressed through obedience, not mere positive thinking. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Make room for someone else's burden.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray for people who oppose me that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Spiritual gifts must be exercised with love, truth, and biblical discernment. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Refuse pride and cultivate a teachable spirit.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my trust steady through difficulties that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: A faithful witness explains repentance, faith, and the hope of salvation. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Let the hope of Christ guide your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, fill my actions with humility that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Love corrects gently and refuses to celebrate wrongdoing. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Serve faithfully even when unnoticed.
topics.prayer: Father, help me speak truth without cruelty that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Do not replace careful Bible study with an attractive slogan. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Listen carefully before speaking.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me in repentance and restitution that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Recognise the limits of your knowledge and remain willing to learn. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Use the opportunity to point to Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, give me grace to serve without recognition that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Christ calls believers to watchfulness, repentance, and faithful service as they await His return. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Remember that grace calls for obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, make my words a source of encouragement that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.prayer: Father, help me honour scripture above popular opinion as I practise the Word I have heard. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom to discern what is right as I practise the Word I have heard. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.

topics.prayer: Father, train my heart to be thankful so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

topics.prayer: Father, teach me to seek peace without hiding wrong so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faithful believers may face trials; hardship is not proof that God has abandoned them. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Hold fast to the truth with gentleness.
topics.prayer: Father, help me listen before answering so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Let the Word of God guide your understanding of spiritual experiences. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Keep your commitments as an act of worship.
topics.prayer: Father, make me steadfast when i am tired so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Care for people's needs without confusing charity with the message of salvation. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Let love and holiness mark your response.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me to support those in distress so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus identifies His disciples by their love; unity must remain rooted in truth. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Trust God rather than forcing an outcome.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to depend on christ rather than myself so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Hearing Scripture without practising it can give a false sense of spiritual maturity. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Examine your conscience under the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my hope anchored in your promises so that I may honour You in private. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Do not treat every strong feeling as a message from God. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Pray over the passage before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, give me courage to admit when i am wrong that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Do not neglect today's responsibilities while speaking about the last days. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Ask how the passage corrects your assumptions.
topics.prayer: Father, keep my heart free from bitterness that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

entries.prayer: Father, guard my speech from pride and anger that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

topics.prayer: Father, help me honour you when no one is watching that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.prayer: Father, teach me to show mercy without compromising truth that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, make me patient when answers are delayed that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, lead me to care for those who are overlooked that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, keep my priorities shaped by eternity that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

topics.prayer: Father, open my eyes to a neighbour's need that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

topics.prayer: Father, help me keep my promises that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.prayer: Father, make my witness sincere and compassionate that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

topics.prayer: Father, give me strength to resist temptation that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

topics.prayer: Father, teach me to forgive as you have forgiven me that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — A Life of Faith

topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful in small responsibilities that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.prayer: Father, help me honour scripture above popular opinion that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom to discern what is right that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray for people who oppose me that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, keep my trust steady through difficulties that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, guide me in repentance and restitution that Christ may be honoured in my choices. Through Jesus Christ, amen.
